new_candidates.requirement: A later fuzz invocation with valid audio input must be able to reach encoding after an earlier invocation requested the version.
new_candidates.target_route: A first input supplies -v; parse_option sets show_version. A second input supplies a valid WAVE file without -v. The entry resets getopt state, but init_options does not reset show_version, so do_it returns before encode_file.
new_candidates.failure_condition: After the first invocation, every later invocation in the same process takes the version return, leaving supported encoding unreachable.
new_candidates.alternative_paths: The complete init_options and free_options bodies do not clear show_version; the complete option parser only sets it. No input option restores the encoding route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The -v option sets the persistent show_version flag.
Without the early version return, do_it routes a supplied file to encode_file.
free_options releases allocations without clearing the version flag.

scope.summary: The selected declaration is inactive under the supplied CMake defaults. A separate, established lifecycle failure prevents encoding after a prior -v input in the same fuzz process.

assessments.reason: The added member is confined to FLAC__INTEGER_ONLY_LIBRARY. The supplied recipe and complete CMake configuration and library rules do not enable that macro; the active floating-point branch already has its wide-predictor member.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete generated-configuration template does not define the integer-only macro.
The complete libFLAC CMake rules add no integer-only definition.

build.reason: The recipe builds and links the CMake libFLAC target with the default, non-integer-only configuration. This is a static recipe assessment, not a claim of an observed build result.

evidence.dependency_reason: These rules include stream_encoder.c in the linked FLAC library and add no integer-only definition.

input.reason: The entry accepts fuzz bytes as bounded command-line arguments and temporary-file contents, then passes the filename to the tool.

evidence.dependency_reason: parse_options consumes the supplied argument vector and records the input filename.

lifecycle.reason: show_version survives free_options and is omitted from init_options, so one -v invocation disables encoding on later inputs in the same process.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry resets getopt state and repeatedly invokes main_to_fuzz without resetting the tool's option structure.

control_flow.reason: After -v latches show_version, do_it returns at its version guard before the encoding branch for later valid inputs.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the encoding branch bypassed by the earlier return.
The harness calls the tool and does not reset its persistent option state afterward.

scope.prior_alarm_resolution: The earlier unknown assessment of g0001 is resolved by the supplied CMake contracts and complete encoder source. The newly visible show_version failure is a separate preexisting foundation blocker.
